老字号，成为年轻人“心头好”（新视窗）: Time-Honored Brands Become Young People's "Favorite" (New Perspectives)
上海南京东路via·1719吴良材新视场门店，老式百年验光操作台与AI（人工智能: At the Wu Liang Cai new vision flagship store on Nanjing Road East via·1719 in Shanghai, a vintage century-old optical testing table and AI (artificial intelligence) eyeglasses are displayed side by side, with many young visitors lining up to try them on.
苏州游客陈红带孩子逛南京路，站在展台前反复试戴设备，忍不住感慨：“记忆里吴良材就: Chen Hong, a visitor from Suzhou, was taking her child shopping on Nanjing Road, standing before the display repeatedly trying on the device, unable to resist exclaiming: "In my memory, Wu Liang Cai was an old shop selling traditional frame eyeglasses. AI交互、大数据研发、线上直播电商，把晦涩的传统知识转化成直观有趣的现代体验: AI interaction, big data research and development, and online livestream e-commerce have transformed obscure traditional knowledge into intuitive and engaging modern experiences.
